simulation_ux.broadcast: live plate-appearance-by-plate-appearance screen with team logos, batter/pitcher headshots where available, inning, outs, occupied bases, score, recent plays, and running batting/pitching box scores
simulation_ux.post_sim: broadcast auto-collapses to a compact final-series scoreboard and can be expanded

simulation_ux.playoffs: active-player selection added to every live playoff matchup; playoff series use the same broadcast experience
